description_en: Queries the major version and minor version of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance and the release notes for minor versions
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的大版本和小版本信息，同时可查询到小版本的发布日志信息
name: DescribeEngineVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

DBLatestMinorVersion.description_en: The latest minor version to which the instance can be updated
DBLatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 该实例当前可升级至最新的小版本信息

Level.description_en:
The version update level. Valid values:

0: regular
1: recommended
2: critical
Level.description_zh:
版本变更的重要性，取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

VersionRelease.description_en: The version update path from the current minor version to the latest minor version of the instance, which is consistent with the version documentation. For more detailed information, you can directly refer to the release notes
VersionRelease.description_zh: 从实例当前小版本到最新小版本的版本演进路线，与版本文档一致，可以直接至版本说明文档查看更详细的信息

ReleaseInfoList.description_en: The information about the minor versions

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the instance

ReleaseNoteEn.description_en: The description of the minor versions to which the instance can be updated
ReleaseNoteEn.description_zh: 可升级的版本英文描述

VersionChangesLevel.description_en:
The version update level, which indicates how strongly the update is recommended. Valid values:

0: regular
1: recommended
2: critical
VersionChangesLevel.description_zh:
版本升级的重要性（推荐升级程度），取值：
0：一般重要
1：比较重要
2：非常重要

DBVersionRelease.description_en: The release notes for the minor version of the instance, including the release date, minor version number, release type such as new feature, and description
DBVersionRelease.description_zh: 实例小版本的更新说明，包含发布时间、小版本号、类型（例如新特性）及详细说明等信息

EnableUpgradeMajorVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance major version can be upgraded. Valid values:

true: The major version can be upgraded.
false: The major version is the latest version and cannot be upgraded.

To upgrade the major version, call the [ModifyInstanceMajorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html） operation
EnableUpgradeMajorVersion.description_zh:
实例是否可升级大版本，返回值：
true：可升级。
false：不可升级，通常已经是最新版本。

如需升级大版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMajorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473776.html）接口

EnableUpgradeMinorVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance minor version can be updated. Valid values:

true: The minor version can be updated.
false: The minor version is the latest version and cannot be updated.

To update the minor version, call the [ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html） operation
EnableUpgradeMinorVersion.description_zh:
实例是否可升级小版本，返回值：

true：可升级。
false：已经是最新版本，不可升级。 

如需升级小版本，请调用[ModifyInstanceMinorVersion]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473777.html）接口

Engine.description_en: The database engine. Valid values: redis and memcache

IsAutoUpgradeOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic minor version update is enabled. Valid values:

0: Automatic minor version update is disabled.
1: Automatic minor version update is enabled
IsAutoUpgradeOpen.description_zh:
是否开启了小版本自动升级，取值：

0：未开启。
1：开启

IsLatestVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance uses the latest minor version. Valid values:

true
false
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
实例的小版本是否为最新，返回值：
true：是。
false：不是

IsNewSSLMode.description_en:
Indicates whether Transport Layer Security (TLS) is enabled. Valid values:

1: TLS is enabled.
0: TLS is disabled
IsNewSSLMode.description_zh:
是否支持新版TLS，取值：
1: 开启
0: 关闭

IsOpenNGLB.description_en:
Indicates whether the NGLB mode is enabled. Valid values:

0: The NGLB mode is disabled.
1: The NGLB mode is enabled
IsOpenNGLB.description_zh:
是否开启NGLB模式，取值：
0：未开启。
1：开启

IsRedisCompatibleVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the instance runs a Redis version

IsSSLEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL is enabled. Valid values:

1: SSL is enabled.
0: TLS is disabled
IsSSLEnable.description_zh:
是否启用SSL，取值：
1: 开启
0: 关闭

MajorVersion.description_en: The major version of the instance

MinorVersion.description_en: The current minor version of the instance

ProxyLatestMinorVersion.description_en: The latest minor version to which the proxy node can be updated
ProxyLatestMinorVersion.description_zh: 该Proxy节点当前可升级至最新的小版本信息

ReleaseInfoList.description_en: The information about the minor versions

ProxyMinorVersion.description_en:
The current minor version of the proxy node.

This parameter is returned only for cluster and read/write splitting instances
ProxyMinorVersion.description_zh:
Proxy代理节点当前的小版本。
仅集群与读写分离架构实例返回本参数

ProxyVersionRelease.description_en:
The release notes for the minor version of proxy nodes. The release notes include the release date, minor version number, release type such as new feature, and description.

This parameter is returned only for cluster and read/write splitting instances
ProxyVersionRelease.description_zh:
Proxy代理节点的小版本更新说明，包含发布时间、小版本号、类型（例如新特性）及详细说明等信息。
仅集群与读写分离架构实例返回本参数
ProxyVersionRelease.example: {\"releaseInfo\":[{\"createTime\":\"2021-06-08\",\"level\":0,\"releaseVersion\":\"6.6.2\",\"releaseNote\":\"新特性：增加对部分内部命令的支持。\"}],\"versionChangesLevel\":2}
